desc: restock-craft leg (#22/#23) — the conditional craft want/min path, live. Bot stands on a small stone platform with ONE iron ingot and zero nuggets. Runs `craft {want:iron_nugget, min:16, chain:[1 ingot→9 nuggets], table:false}`: below min (0<16) AND ingredients present → it crafts (2×2 player grid, no table). PASS = a CRAFT event (the manual-grid place→take fired). This is the with-materials path the sustain loop's restock leg takes once the furnace bank has cooked ingots; the skip-when-short path is proven by the sustain-cycle arena (CRAFT_NO_MATERIALS) + unit tests.
